title: Dashcam Captures Moment SUV Crashes Into Tulsa Police Car
description:
** (Disclaimer: This video content is intended for educational and informational purposes only) **
Tulsa police released new dash cam footage which shows an officer texting while driving seconds before getting in a wreck. The other driver was at fault after police say the driver crossed the median. 

Article Source: https://ktul.com/news/local/video-tulsa-police-officer-caught-texting-while-driving-before-crash
